This is an implementation within `bevy_window::window` that fixes #12229. 

# Objective

Fixes #12229, allow users to retrieve the window's size and physical size as Vectors without having to manually construct them using `height()` and `width()` or `physical_height()` and `physical_width()` 

## Solution

As suggested in #12229, created two public functions within `window`: `size() -> Vec` and `physical_size() -> UVec` that return the needed Vectors ready-to-go.

### Discussion

My first FOSS PRQ ever, so bear with me a bit. I'm new to this.

- I replaced instances of ```Vec2::new(window.width(), window.height());``` or `UVec2::new(window.physical_width(), window.physical_height());` within bevy examples be replaced with their `size()`/`physical_size()` counterparts?
- Discussion within #12229 still holds: should these also be added to WindowResolution?

issue_context.title: Add `size` and `physical_size` to `Window`
issue_context.body:
## What problem does this solve or what need does it fill?

Users shouldn't need to manually construct vector types when they want to work with window sizes.

An example of some common code:

https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/499c978176435efaaf8ccfe3a1141efadfd340eb/examples/stress_tests/bevymark.rs#L512

## What solution would you like?

Provide

```rust
fn size() -> Vec2 {}
fn physical_size() -> UVec2 {}
```

## What alternative(s) have you considered?

Doing nothing is always an option, it is not terribly difficult to do this yourself.

## Discussion

Should these also be added to `WindowResolution`?
comments: I'd like to work on this :)
